name: Cồn Quy
kicker: Longan orchard on the Tiền, beside Cồn Phụng
summary: Longan orchard on the Tiền: walk the trees, drink honey tea, and bail a ditch for fish on the same boat day. The ride often continues from Cồn Phụng. Skip it when the nine-dragon court is the only stop you wanted. Ask the crew where this orchard lets you off.
timeNeeded: A stop on the river day
getThere: By boat, often with Cồn Phụng. Ask the crew for this stop.
heroCaption: A longan garden path on Cồn Quy

notice.title: Ask the crew about the blossom
notice.body: The month for longan blossom is a question for the orchard. The nine-dragon court is on Cồn Phụng.

body: Walk a longan orchard, drink honey tea, and bail a ditch for fish to cook when the crew offers it. A month for the blossom is a question for the orchard. Quy sits with the other names on this bank of the Tiền. Use the boat's own directions for the stop.

The same boat that reaches Cồn Phụng often continues here. A separate fare is a question for that boat. The visit is the orchard path and a sampan in the creek. The four names are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Lân has no bank named.

figures.caption: A sampan in the nipa creek on Cồn Quy
figures.alt: A rower in a sampan on a palm creek at Cồn Quy

gettingThere: Come by boat, often the boat that also calls at Cồn Phụng. Ask the crew for this stop. The Cồn Phụng kilometers belong to that islet. The landing is on this bank of the Tiền. Thới Sơn is the Mỹ Tho side.

legs.heading: From Ben Tre
legs.body: By boat, often the same boat as Cồn Phụng. Minutes and the fare are a question for the crew.

closed: No weekly closing day is posted.
admissionNote: Ask the boat for a fare of its own. The Cồn Phụng gate stays at that islet.
